target.title: refactor(sessions): keep late-media attachment text out of persisted transcripts
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Follow-up to #111204, same leak class: when media resolves *after* the admitted user turn already crossed the LLM boundary, the late-media path appends a second user turn whose persisted `content` is literal `[media attached: <path>]` lines. All clients render transcript content verbatim, so users see wire scaffolding under the image.

## Why This Change Was Made

Same bare-storage pattern the timestamp stamping and #111204 established: transcripts persist bare; the LLM boundary projects model-facing text deterministically.

- `buildLateResolvedMediaMessage` now persists bare content (empty string / filtered blocks, keeping real captions and image payload blocks) plus a `__openclaw.lateMedia` marker, protected through `beforeMessageWrite` hooks so a hook cannot silently change provider-visible bytes.
- `normalizeMessagesForLlmBoundary` projects the `[media attached: …]` lines for marked blank turns (`buildLateMediaAttachedText`, same canonical `path ?? url` selection as before); unmarked blank media turns keep the #111204 `MEDIA_ONLY_USER_TEXT` behavior — the two paths are disjoint by the marker.
- History-image pruning runs *before* the boundary, so blank marked turns are materialized at the prune stage too; the scrubber replaces refs with its non-blank marker, so pruned turns never re-trigger boundary synthesis and legacy/marked forms prune to identical bytes.
- Media-field sniffing deduped into a shared `hasPersistedMedia` (trimmed semantics, now also covering `MediaUrl`/`MediaUrls`).
- Legacy transcripts with the persisted literal replay unchanged (non-blank content skips projection).

## User Impact

Late-resolved media renders as just the image (plus any real caption) in every client — no synthetic `[media attached: …]` subtitle. Provider-visible bytes are unchanged across current turns, replay, pruned history, and legacy transcripts. Net −4 production LOC.

## Evidence

- Boundary equality tests: marked bare turns and legacy literal turns normalize to identical provider bytes (string, array+image-block, empty-array-fallback, URL-only, multi-entry, timestamp interaction); ordinary media-only turns still get `MEDIA_ONLY_USER_TEXT`.
- Prune parity tests: marked and legacy turns prune identically without touching real captions; cache-stability suite covers append-only late-media persistence and exact projection.
- Hook regression: `lateMedia` marker survives `beforeMessageWrite`.
- Suites green via `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs`: user-turn-transcript 37/37, attempt.llm-boundary 31/31 (rerun post-rebase), replay-history 37/37, get-reply-run.media-only 101/101, history-image-prune 14/14, llm-boundary.cache-stability 14/14.
- Autoreview (Codex gpt-5.6-sol): clean, "patch is correct (0.88)".
